questions.q: What are the four stages of love in Shetty's model, in order?
questions.why: Lesson 1 lists solitude, compatibility, healing and connection.

questions.q: What is the purpose of the solitude stage?
a: To prepare for love by being happy alone
To protect love after a breakup
questions.why: Solitude is where we prepare for love and learn to love ourselves.

questions.q: What does 'Your partner is your guru' mean?
a: Someone you learn with, from and through
questions.why: Rule 4 says a long-term partner should also be a long-term teacher.

questions.q: How should couples handle conflict, per 'Win or lose together'?
a: Face the situation as a team rather than each other
questions.why: Rule 6 says approach conflicts as a team.

questions.q: What does lesson 3 offer to cement new views on love?
questions.why: Lesson 3 gives a love-letter prompt and a meditation for each stage.
